rationale: The price action has shown a failure to break below the $7.71 low, followed by a bounce back toward the $7.80 level, which is approaching the session VWAP. Given the loss of downward momentum and the recent uptick in price, the original thesis of a clean move to the 9-EMA support ($7.72) has been invalidated by the current consolidation and reversal. Closing the position now locks in the current profit and avoids the risk of a further retracement toward the VWAP.
